from pathlib import Path
import collections
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u071/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import defaultdict, deque

def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    best_color, best_size = None, 0
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            queue = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            size = 0
            while queue:
                y, x = queue.popleft()
                size += 1
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < rows and 0 <= xx < cols and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        queue.append((yy,xx))
            if size > best_size:
                best_color, best_size = color, size
    return [[best_color] * 3 for _ in range(3)]
'''
p=program_dir/'task-56649e05.py'
p.write_text(source)
print(p)
